requirements.title: 每根已收盘bar的因果状态
requirements.requirement: 状态只能使用截至该bar收盘的已知行情。未来行情可作为预测训练标签，联合方案允许相应损失更新编码器；未来真实值不得倒灌编码输入或自由外推过程。
requirements.acceptance: 未来扰动/截断不改已有状态，训练后权重也要检查。

requirements.title: 行情信息压缩，而非拟合几条规则
requirements.requirement: 价格路径、局部形态和有用成交/持仓活动应易于读取；允许有损压缩，不要求100%还原所有影线。
requirements.acceptance: 分开当前字段、近中远历史、活动、困难样本和冻结用途；图形像不像不作唯一验收。

requirements.title: bar状态与序列状态的关系明确
requirements.requirement: 声明每个状态H_t的实际可见区间、分辨率、归一预热与运行记忆；z_t=E(H_t)可作该历史的序列表示。内部token或短前缀不得冒称同等完整历史。固定128滚动是旧实例，不再限制新架构。
requirements.acceptance: 同物理端点/上下文评价；短前缀冷启动、完整滚动与长期记忆分开。

requirements.title: 价格与数据处理可追溯
requirements.requirement: 以真实合约和时间区间处理，不拼连续主力；价格锚点/尺度、全部预热依赖、缺失活动、分区跨度及train-only统计明确。
requirements.acceptance: 每轮协议绑定原始数据和统计来源；数据窗口/标签和缓存核对；没有独立复算的部分注明。

requirements.title: 状态可复用，可支持分类/趋势/波动等用途
requirements.requirement: 冻结embedding后验证用途，配同信息原始输入、PCA、当前特征和简单指标基线；不把重训主模型拟合评价规则当语义学习。
requirements.acceptance: 同权重、同读取机会及事前门槛；历史状态描述不等于未来收益或开仓建议。

requirements.title: 保留未来逐bar外推方向
requirements.requirement: 真实新bar刷新后预测与没有新行情的自由概率递推分开；若预测真实未来embedding，其目标应是E(H_(t+h))，不可把缺少未来新bar的历史状态当真值。旧固定128示例仍是E(2..129)而非E(2..128)；概率头内部u不自动等同真实encoder状态。
requirements.acceptance: 状态相似度与新增价格增益分别评价；按步长给误差/基线skill/可用范围，不用未来重置或重新锚定。

requirements.title: 研究必须可归因、可证伪并逐步收敛
requirements.requirement: 固定来源、对照、预算、目标、选择和停止条件；失败配方不无限加轮数，不将保留研究模型称全局最优。
requirements.acceptance: 每轮只回答编号问题，记录有限结论、取舍和停止决定；最终独立留出另验。

requirements.title: 高效、可恢复的AutoDL交付
requirements.requirement: 本地只做合成测试/CPU数据与报告核验；真实模型在AutoDL；features/babel准备推送；成功失败均导出到/root/autodl-tmp/download。
requirements.acceptance: 可运行时一次给完整启动/恢复/导出命令；同批必要对照，资源预算明确，不删除来源来过预检。

requirements.title: 每轮更新计划并按六方面复查
requirements.requirement: 写代码前声明编号；每个tar识别、复核、更新结论和队列；完成代码/计划都复查目标、架构、损失训练、验证及数据工程。
requirements.acceptance: 持久项目规则、逐项台账和追加事件；不把未验证标完成，不丢旧假设。

architecture.hierarchical: first2 within-scale causal market-token attention; last4 cross-scale time/scale prior; current state token read-only to market tokens
architecture.prior: equal total prior mass per available scale; normalized exp(-trading_age/T_head) within scale; T=32,128,512,2048,8192,infinity each2 heads; log-space computation; softmax tau1
architecture.parameter_fairness: same parameter shapes and shared seed initialization; fixed masks/prior differ; no same-compute claim
limits: finite declared history, no infinite-state claim
coarse history does not preserve unobserved minute order
state tokens and runtime KV/buffers are distinct
architecture.state_token_mask: All arms: state reads all available market tokens and itself; market tokens never read state. First2 within-scale mask in B/C applies only market-to-market. Per-market query mask/prior uses its own availability, not endpoint t.
architecture.cross_resolution: Shared physical content has deterministic aggregation relations, not equality of full latent states. First matrix uses same-source views/shared encoder/physical targets, no extra cross-scale consistency loss; F04 supervision hypothesis retained separately.
architecture.state_self_logit_reference: open_run_card_detail_before_implementation; formula applies to eligible market keys, state self key relative reference must be fixed
architecture.proposal_status: 6/768/12 and fixed-prior hierarchy are resource/design proposals; relation-bias/type mapping selection pending section3.8

historical_decoder.input: z and physical interval query only; declared price reference for absolute display
historical_decoder.current_close: known reference excluded from reconstruction success; current shape/activity supervised
historical_decoder.constraints: positive price and OHLC geometry; nonnegative log1p V/OI; signed deltaOI derived
historical_decoder.query_encoding: physical end-age/duration/resolution; exact numerical encoding open_run_card_detail

objectives.historical: 0.6 price +0.2 shape +0.2 activity, proposal not optimality claim
objectives.price: half relative path, half adjacent differences derived from predictions
objectives.scale_and_age: fixed train field/period scales; view-average and valid agebands1-16/17-64/>64; age0 separate; missing not zero
objectives.future: teacher-forced Student-t conditional NLL over60 trading-minute returns; sigma fixed at origin; free-rollout evaluated separately
objectives.future_decoder: 2-layer GRU256, initialized and conditioned each step on z; nu2+softplus, positive scale floor; no fabricated future volume/OI
objectives.joint_lambda: encoder-only ramp first10% updates to0.1 then fixed, proposal
objectives.gradient_control: A/B future head receives detached z; C sends lambda*future gradient to encoder; all future head parameters get unweighted future objective; separate optimizers/clipping avoid unintended encoder changes
objectives.age0_mix: supervised and separately evaluated; final mixing weight against historical agebands open_run_card_detail

fairness.not_identified: full architecture x objective interaction; no flat+joint arm
fairness.selection: lastN primary; predeclared best secondary only
fairness.after_training: freeze all encoders; fit equally initialized/budgeted current-state and AR/direct-quantile readouts; raw/simple baselines
fairness.parameter_match_scope: same parameter shapes only for original fixed-prior A/B/C draft; if learnable relation/type mapping selected, requalify controls and disclose effective parameters/compute

optimizer_proposal.name: AdamW
optimizer_proposal.precision: uniform BF16 only if device/numeric qualified; critical targets/metrics sufficient precision

split_proposal.qualification: all input/warmup/query/forecast support within assigned partition for strict score; online-known-past score separate; no train/stat/pretrain final holdout

evaluation.uncertainty: paired contract-time and week/month groups, not overlapping-minute iid bootstrap

acceptance_proposal.B_vs_A: price content MSE gain>=5%; recent16/current body <=5% degradation; core activity and tail<=10%
acceptance_proposal.C_vs_B: fresh frozen-head CRPS gain>=3% and positive skill vs simple baseline, same retention floors
acceptance_proposal.required: grouped interval support and pre-score support/power qualification; thresholds not inherited as facts or fitted after result
acceptance_proposal.C_vs_A_promotion_guard: C must also meet same history retention floors versus ordinary A before replacement; beating a weaker B is insufficient
acceptance_proposal.metric_aggregation: cross-field/product aggregation, primary readout and multiple-comparison order must be locked before candidate scores
